name: Bee Hotel Sample Hotel
description: One-step installer that builds a complete demo hotel (Drupal, BAT and Commerce entities) for evaluation or training.
project_description: Bee Hotel Sample Hotel installs a full demo property in one step. On enable, its hook_install runs SampleHotelInstall which orchestrates SampleHotelInstallDrupal, SampleHotelInstallBat and SampleHotelInstallCommerce to create the Drupal content, BAT units/events and Commerce products/stores that make up a working sample hotel. Uninstalling removes them. It is intended for evaluation, demos and training.
